notes.title: Patch Note V.0.5.1 - Duriano
notes.notes: [p]Hello, everyone! Following the release of Patch 0.5.1, we noticed some issues with the new [b]Morning Star[/b] weapon. We've taken action and given a small buff to its augments in this patch, along with various bug fixes.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, we've updated the UI and added Japanese language support to celebrate Duriano's participation[b] [/b]in [b]the Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b] in Japan.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Feature Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]QoL for permanent upgrade[/p][list][*][p][b]Permanent Upgrades[/b] will now show all upcoming upgrade tiers you have not yet unlocked. These will be marked with a symbol to let you know how many more tiers are waiting[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]General Gameplay Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Rework Blacksmith system[/p][list][*][p]Now the Blacksmith chamber will no longer give players a free augment. Instead, it is now a shop that sells augments at a random discount[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Change augment’s rarity chance[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the random chance for all augments to appear in the shop[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Balance Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Buff Morning Star’s augment[/p][list][*][p]Grasp of Warrior’s special effect damage from 50 + 50% Physical Damage > 50 + 100% Physical Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Core of Destruction’s token duration increases from 5 seconds > 15 seconds and token damage from 50 + 100% of Physical Damage > 50 + 200% of Physical Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]God’s skill rework[/p][list][*][p]Forseti’s skill[/p][list][*][p]God’s skill level 1: Gain Shield equal 100% of Max HP, +200 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 200% of player's current Shield to all enemies[/p][/*][*][p]God’s skill level 2: Gain Shield equal 150% of Max HP, +500 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 200% of player's current Shield to all enemies[/p][/*][*][p]God’s skill level 3: Gain Shield equal 200% of Max HP, +1000 Thorn for 6 seconds and after 3 seconds, explode 90% of Shield that player have and deal damage equal 500% of player's current Shield to all enemies[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mimir’s skill[/p][list][*][p]God’s skill level 1: +20 Spell Damage for 5 seconds and deal damage 50 + 50% Spell Damage + 50% Trail Pray to all enemies and inflict Burn for 7 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Aegir’s skill[/p][list][*][p]God’s skill level 3: +25 Life Steal and +35 Evasion for 5 seconds. Summon 3 Spirit of the dept for 7 seconds that will attack projectile to the nearest enemy for every 0.2 seconds and global range, deal damage 50 + 500% Life Steal. After 7 seconds, the Big Spirit of the dept will detonate to deal damage 1000 + 10000% Life Steal[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Menu & UI Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Update Japanese Localization[/p][/*][*][p]New UI for result scene[/p][/*][*][p]New main menu UI[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where player fall out of map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the animation background not working when switch screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where player’s HP doesn't equal 0 when player die[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where player can’t lock item in shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the name text for the Xbox joystick displayed incorrectly[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Note V.0.5.0 - Duriano
notes.notes:
[p]We’ve carefully listened to every comment and suggestion, and this patch overhauls the core experience: revamped systems based on player feedback, tighter balance for fair but challenging combat, and most importantly, brand-new content that will shake up your battles.[/p][p]Get ready for a [b]Viking-style hero[/b], [b]ruthless new weapons[/b], and [b]deadly enemy monsters[/b]!

notes.title: Duriano Patch 0.4.0: A New Challenge Awaits!
notes.notes:
[p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/15072b11ec54f3903dd902268308a7b234759f2c.png"][/img][/p][p]The Duriano development team is incredibly excited to announce a significant update: [b]Patch 0.4.0[/b], which is now ready to elevate your gaming experience to new heights of intensity and challenge. This update focuses on game balance adjustments, the introduction of new difficulty levels, and various content improvements to ensure Duriano remains an unforgettable adventure.[/p][p]We have consistently gathered valuable feedback and suggestions from our players, using them to continuously refine and improve the game. Patch 0.4.0 is the result of that unwavering commitment. We are confident that these changes will bring about thrilling new challenges and well-deserved rewards for those who earn them.[/p][p][b]Key Updates in Patch 0.4.0[/b][/p][p]General Gameplay Update[/p][list][*][p]Boss's Mechanics Rework: Surtr, The First Giant
Surtr will no longer be a pushover! After being a punching bag for too long, we decided to make him a true boss. Surtr now has 13 new moves, spread across different difficulty levels. As the difficulty goes up, Surtr's moves become even more dangerous. Watch out, because this fire giant is getting serious![/p][/*][*][p]Miniboss Damage Reduced
We decided to slightly lower miniboss damage. This is because the new, harder difficulties greatly increase monster damage, and we don't want players to be overwhelmed by our minibosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Contest Chamber Now Gives a Little Bit EXP
We decided to give contest chambers a small amount of EXP. This is because EXP is very important for players to survive the tough monsters right now, especially with the new, harder difficulty levels added in the update.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Slow Motion when Using God's Trails or Succeeding Dodge Boss's Skill by Dash
We tried to make the game more exciting, but the slow-motion effect for God's Trails and successful boss dodges made gameplay feel less smooth. So, we've decided to remove this slow-motion feature.[/p][/*][*][p]New Permanent Stat Added: Thorn (Tier 4)
Unlocked when all Tier 3 permanent stats reach max level. Prepare for unparalleled defensive power![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Feature Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Difficulty Mode: Duriano
Test the fury of Duriano! Face a new difficulty mode that will push your limits. Battle through harsh environments and unbelievably strong enemies. Prove you are a true warrior who can conquer the Duriano![/p][/*][*][p]New achievement: Welcome to Valhalla[/p][p]Unlock when win the Duriano difficulty for the first time, a special achievement awaits: Welcome to Valhalla. This is a symbol of honor, demonstrating your exceptional abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Buffed Jötunnshard and its Augments
This weapon was still weak in the last update, so we will buff it a little.[/p][list][*][p][b]Jötunnshard[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now +1 Split Shot[/p][/*][*][p]Now +1 Split Shot for every 10 player's levels[/p][/*][*][p]This weapon's Split Shot will now deal 100% damage and can receive attack effects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Frozen Tear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Removed +1 Split Shot[/p][/*][*][p]Ice wind damage scaling changed from 100% Spell Damage > 150% Spell Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Ice of Eternity[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trail Pray damage amplification changed from 25% > 50%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Absolute Zero Seal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Frozen burst damage scaling changed from 150% Spell Damage > 200% Spell Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Augment's Crit Damage changed from 0 > We are committed to continuously improving Duriano in the future and extend our gratitude for your continued support and loyalty.[/p][p]Prepare yourselves for the new battles, and conquer the Duriano difficulty![/p][p]Good luck on your adventures.[/p]

notes.title: Duriano Update 0.3.2: A New Dimension of Combat and Adventure!
notes.notes: [p]Brave gamers, prepare yourselves for an exhilarating new adventure in the world of Duriano! Patch 0.3.2 is here, poised to elevate your gaming experience to unprecedented heights. This isn't just a minor rebalance or a typical bug fix;  this patch represents a monumental transformation that will leave you in awe![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay Update: Conquer Bosses for Ultimate Power-Ups![/b][/h3][p]The most thrilling enhancement in this update is the [b]improved Mini-Boss item drop system![/b] From now on, every Mini-Boss is [b]guaranteed to drop a Tier 4 item chest[/b] upon defeat! This significantly increases your opportunities to acquire rare and potent items, bolstering your character's strength. Get ready for Mini-Boss hunts that are more intense and rewarding than ever before![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Balance Adjustments: Familiar Heroes, Newfound Strength![/b][/h3][p]Naturally, balance adjustments are at the core of every update, and Patch 0.3.2 delivers without disappointment![/p][p]The [b]Ice Phoenix Sorcerer has received a significant buff![/b] Previously, this character faced considerable limitations with high Life Steal and EXP Gain Rate penalties. Now, both values have been reduced to just -25, granting the Ice Phoenix Sorcerer remarkably improved survivability and leveling efficiency! It's time for the ice mage to rise to prominence once again![/p][p][/p][h4][b]Jötunnshard's Augment is now even more powerful![/b][/h4][list][*][p][b]Frozen Tear:[/b] Has been upgraded to include [b]+1 Split Shot[/b], increasing its potential for area-of-effect damage and making group attacks significantly more effective.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wrath of Winter:[/b] The [b]Frost Token requirement has been reduced from 4 to 3[/b], allowing you to utilize Wrath of Winter more frequently and inflict continuous ice damage.[/p][/*][/list][h4][b]Augment Improvements for Bows and Arrows:[/b][/h4][list][*][p][b]Frigg's Aurora Quiver:[/b]  Has undergone a major effect change! Previously, the buff from Blessing of Mother's Land reduced enemy speed. Now, it provides [b]+5000 Thorn and +15 Armor![/b] This alteration empowers bow users to better withstand enemy attacks and introduces new strategic combat approaches![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]New Feature Update: Pause Game, Anytime![/b][/h3][p]Tired of being interrupted in the heat of battle? Fret no more! Duriano Patch 0.3.2 introduces a [b]new Pause System[/b] that allows you to halt the game at any moment, providing enhanced flexibility during your gameplay sessions![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Art & VFX Update: Aesthetic Harmony![/b][/h3][p]Beyond gameplay refinements, Duriano places a significant emphasis on visual beauty and effects![/p][list][*][p]The [b]Ice Phoenix Sorcerer has received a new texture![/b] Prepare to be captivated by the stunning new appearance and sharper details of the Ice Phoenix Sorcerer, making you fall in love with this character's elegance.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]icon and name of Arrow Darts of Hodr have been changed![/b] They will now be known as [b]Edge of Fortune[/b], accompanied by a new, more aggressive and formidable icon![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes: A Seamless, Flawless Experience![/b][/h3][p]The Duriano team has diligently worked to resolve various issues previously encountered by players, aiming to deliver the most seamless gaming experience possible![/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue causing a black screen when players set the resolution to 3420x1930.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the cut-in for the Aegir god's skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Healing Herb not being collected when HP is full.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing players from continuing the game when possessing Eir's Undaunted Shield and Eir's Life Force Aura.[/p][/*][/list][p]Duriano Patch 0.3.2 is a pivotal update that will introduce a fresh, challenging, and more exciting gaming experience than ever before! Whether you are a veteran player or new to the world of Duriano, it's time to step into this realm and immerse yourself in the grandeur of this update! Prepare for endless adventure![/p][p]Are you ready to delve into the transformed world of Duriano and experience power beyond what you've ever known?[/p]

notes.title: Duriano 0.2.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Update [b]0.2.4[/b] introduces a major step forward in the player experience with the new [b]Save Progression System[/b], alongside refreshed boss visuals, new background music tracks, and key bug fixes. Here’s everything included in this update:

[b][h3]Tweaks & Improvements[/h3][/b][list][*]Players can now [b]save and resume progress[/b] between sessions.[/*][*]Added a slight [b]navigation delay[/b] when the new UI is shown.[/*][*]Refreshed textures and models for several enemies and bosses:[/*][list][*][b]Surtr[/b]: Updated model, sword, and mount textures[/*][*][b]Spicy Spider[/b]: New texture and improved visual detailing[/*][*][b]Chili Spirit[/b]: New texture for main body and animated tentacles[/*][*][b]All bosses and mini-bosses[/b]: Visual updates to improve visual clarity and personality[/*][/list][*]New background music tracks have been added for multiple chamber types:[/*][list][*][b]Contest Chamber[/b]: 1 new BGM added (total 2 random BGM)[/*][*][b]Horde Chamber[/b]: 1 new BGM added (total 2 random BGM)[/*][*][b]Normal Chamber[/b]: 2 new BGMs added (total 5 random BGM)[/*][/list][/list][b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b][list][*][b]Fixed[/b] a bug where the player would [b]auto-walk[/b] without pressing any movement key after unpausing.[/*][*][b]Fixed[/b] an issue where [b]Fate’s Flavor: Deflective Eir’s Strike (Eir)[/b] did not function as described.[/*][*][b]Fixed[/b] a visual bug where the [b]free augment[/b] in the blacksmith displayed the [b]wrong background[/b] when locked and then rerolled.[/*][*][b]Fixed[/b] a UI issue where the [b]Fate’s Flavor description pop-up[/b] remained on screen after reopening the [b]Pause Menu[/b].[/*][*][b]Fixed[/b] an inconsistency where the item [b]“Sacred Sword Sheath Freyr”[/b] effect did not match its description.[/*][/list]
This patch adds atmosphere, polish, and a much-requested feature that brings [u]Duriano[/u] one step closer to full release. As always, thank you for your feedback and support — and stay tuned for more surprises in the next update.

notes.title: Duriano 0.2.2f2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Duriano 0.2.2f2 Patch Notes – Gameplay, UI, and Core System Improvements[/b][/h1]
The journey through the Nine Realms continues in [u]Duriano[/u] with update [b]0.2.2f2[/b]. This patch focuses on [b]gameplay feel[/b], [b]VFX polish[/b], and a long list of critical [b]bug fixes[/b] tied to augments, blessings, and progression. As always, your feedback is what keeps pushing the game forward — and we’re thrilled to share what’s improved.
[h2]
[b]Tweaks & Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][b]Slow motion effect[/b] added when:[/*][list][*]Activating a [b]God’s Trail[/b][/*][*]Successfully [b]dodging a boss skill[/b] with a dash
 These moments now feel more impactful and cinematic.[/*][/list][*]Adjusted drop probabilities to improve progression pacing:[/*][list][*]Explosion Egg: 36%[/*][*]EXP Egg: 30%[/*][*]Norse Coin Egg: 30%[/*][*]Treasure Crate Egg: 4%[/*][/list][*]Added a new [b]Gameplay Tutorial UI[/b] to guide new players through the basics of combat and progression.[/*][/list][list][*]Improved and optimized VFX for several key items:[/*][list][*]Jewel Scale of Jormungandr[/*][*]Elf Earrings[/*][*]Arrow Darts of Hodr[/*][*]Thousand-Year-Old Vine[/*][*]Heimdall’s Horn (Gjallarhorn)[/*][*]Freyja’s Thorned Circlet[/*][*]Valkyrie’s Wings[/*][*]Aegir’s Ocean Belt[/*][/list][*]Sound fades out briefly when a [b]God’s Trail[/b] is activated, enhancing dramatic timing.[/*][*]Adjusted [b]Bow & Arrows[/b] sound cooldown to better match its rapid-fire rhythm.[/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*]Fixed Fate’s Flavor Level 2 effects function bug in this list[/*][list][*]Fernbound Armament (Forseti)[/*][*]Druidic Vitality Blessing (Forseti)[/*][*]Mystic Forseti's Armor Ward (Forseti)[/*][*]Seer's Healthbound Harmony (Mimir)[/*][*]Mimir's Trail of Rune Mastery (Mimir)[/*][*]Visionary Mimir's Rune Torrent (Mimir)[/*][*]Mystical Echo Trails (Frigg)[/*][*]Echoic Reverie (Frigg)[/*][*]Harmonic Echo Spiral (Frigg)[/*][*]Vidar's Rune of Vengeance (Vidar)[/*][*]Titan's Wrath (Vidar)[/*][*]Impervious Impact (Vidar)[/*][*]Eir's Impenetrable Assault (Eir)[/*][*]Deflective Eir's Strike (Eir)[/*][*]Eir's Spell Blessing (Eir)[/*][*]Hodr's Blessing (Hodr)[/*][*]Hodr's Blitzkrieg (Hodr)[/*][*]Hodr's Elegance (Hodr)[/*][*]Hodr's Tranquility (Hodr)[/*][/list][*]Resolved a bug where [b]Bow & Arrows augments[/b] were still active in the [b]Prophet[/b] and [b]Blacksmith[/b] chambers scene.[/*][*]Fixed an issue where [b]eggs could not be destroyed[/b].[/*][*]Fixed bugs where monsters spawn [b]inside pillars[/b].

[/*][/list][h2][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/h2]
This patch is all about improving the gameplay loop, tightening responsiveness, and clearing out bugs. We're actively working on the next phase of development.

Thank you for being part of the [b]Duriano[/b] community. To all the brave [b]Durianians[/b] out there, your feedback continues to shape the Nine Realms.

notes.title: Duriano 0.2.1f1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for joining us at the start of Duriano's Early Access journey!
 This 0.2.1 patch brings the first round of fixes and polish based on what we’ve seen so far.
 We're hard at work on the next big update, and we can't wait to show you more.

[b]Tweaks & Improvements[/b]
[list][*]
Hard difficulty is now locked until Normal difficulty is cleared.
[/*][*]
Hell difficulty is now locked until Hard difficulty is cleared.
[/*][*]
Players can now use shortcut keys to perform the following actions:
[list][*]
[b]Character Selection[/b]: Rotate, focus current selection, focus current menu, confirm, reset
[/*][*]
[b]Level-up Fate, Shop, Blacksmith[/b]: Reroll, confirm, toggle lock state
[/*][*]
[b]All UIs with a stat panel[/b]: Toggle stat menu
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Improved navigation with a small rotation animation when selecting buttons.
[/*][*]
Adjusted and optimized all maps in Muspelheim for better performance and gameplay flow.
[/*][/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]
Fixed the attack range issues for Pepper Elemental and Hot of Tamer enemies.
[/*][*]
Fixed a bug where players couldn’t move after being revived.
[/*][*]
Fixed incorrect effects for all Fate Flavor Level 2 upgrades that use "Every stat."
[/*][*]
Fixed a damage calculation bug with the Jewel Scale of Jormungandr (T3014).
[/*][*]
Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck during scene loading when entering the Blacksmith Chamber.
[/*][/list]
Thanks again for playing and being part of the Duriano adventure!

notes.title: Latest Development Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102131/f62e360289064608a3b6fd9e32a9402de86e585f.png[/img][h1][b]Duriano Current Update: Latest Development Progress & Early Access Goals[/b][/h1]
Greetings, warriors of Asgard!

We’re thrilled to share the latest updates on Duriano, our action-packed [b]rogue-lite[/b] inspired by [b]Norse mythology[/b]. We’ve made significant progress, and we want to give you an inside look at what’s playable, what’s coming next, and how you can be part of shaping Duriano before its official release!

[h2][b]Current Development Status[/b][/h2]
The current version of Duriano is [b]fully playable[/b], featuring:
[list][*][b]7 Playable Duriano Heroes[/b] – Each with unique abilities and combat styles.[/*][*][b]5 Mythical Weapons[/b] – Inspired by Norse legends, each with game-changing upgrades.[/*][*][b]Enemy Swarms & Boss Battles[/b] – Face off against enemies of Norse mythology.[/*][*][b]Fate’s Favor System[/b] – Customize your build by choosing blessings.[/*][*][b]Procedural Combat Arenas[/b] – No two runs are the same, with dynamically generated levels and enemy placements.[/*][*][b]3 Difficulty Levels[/b] – Players can choose from [b]Normal, Hard, and Hell Mode[/b], each offering a unique challenge.[/*][/list]
Our focus has been refining [b]combat fluidity, progression balance, and enemy variety[/b] to ensure every run feels intense, rewarding, and fun!

[h2][b]Early Access Goals[/b][/h2]
We plan to fully launch Duriano [b]Soon[/b] to let players experience the core game while we continue polishing and expanding the world. Our early access roadmap includes:
[list][*][b]More Playable Heroes[/b] – Expanding more [b]unique Duriano Hero[/b].
[/*][*][b]New Weapons & Skills[/b] – Unlock [b]more mythical weapons[/b] and a [b]deep upgrade system[/b].

[/list][h2][b]What’s Next?[/b][/h2]
We’re currently fine-tuning [b]game balance, performance optimization, and UI improvements[/b]. Our team is also adding [b]new enemies, animations, and combat mechanics[/b] to keep Duriano fresh and exciting!

[h2][b]Join the Battle & Share Your Feedback![/b][/h2]
Warriors of Asgard, we need you! Your feedback is shaping Duriano into the best game it can be. Share your thoughts, report bugs, and suggest ideas in our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/eN6jaatJtz]community forums[/url][/b]

Thank you for being part of this journey—Ragnarok awaits, and only the strongest Duriano hero will survive!

Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare for battle!
